title: A disable race can create a review after repository opt-out
problem: The enabled-config check completes before the GitHub request. A disable can commit while that request runs. The disable path finds no run to supersede. This task then creates a new run from the stale config object. The workflow never checks enabled, so it can post a verdict after the user disables the repository.
suggestion: Lock and reload the config inside the creation transaction. Recheck enabled, installation_id, and connected_by_user_id before creating the run. The disable will then happen before the check or supersede the committed run afterward.
